name: CHARMM19 united atom
references: E. Neria, S. Fischer, M. Karplus, J. Chem. Phys. 105, 1902 (1996)

atom_types.name: H
atom_types.description: H that can H-bond to neutral atom

atom_types.name: HC
atom_types.description: H that can H-bond to charged atom

atom_types.name: NH1
atom_types.description: peptide nitrogen bound to one hydrogen

atom_types.name: NH2
atom_types.description: peptide nitrogen bound to two hydrogen

atom_types.name: NH3
atom_types.description: peptide nitrogen bound to three hydrogen

atom_types.name: NC2
atom_types.description: charged guanidinuim nitrogen bound to two hydrogens

atom_types.name: NR
atom_types.description: nitrogen in aromatic ring with no hydrogens

atom_types.name: CT
atom_types.description: Aliphatic C atom with no H.

atom_types.name: SH1E
atom_types.description: Extended atom sulphur with one hydrogen

notes: CHARMM19 is a polar-hydrogen (united-atom) force field
converted by CAPS (CHARMM19, unit kcal/mol); equivalences replace the type name for each kind of parameter
validation: checked term by term against the reference DL_POLY FIELD file (bench/ff/validate_family.py): butane, octane, ethanol and the original C18 alkane example identical.
